presets.name: Follow the chords
presets.description: Fits every note to the chord sounding in the song; notes between the beats stay in the key.

presets.name: Chord tones only
presets.description: Every note lands on a note of the chord sounding, on the beat or not.

presets.name: In key
presets.description: Moves any note outside the song's key to its nearest note in it.

presets.name: Up a third in key
presets.description: Two steps of the key up: a harmony a third above, major or minor where it lands.

presets.name: Down a sixth in key
presets.description: Five steps of the key down: the line a sixth below, staying in the key.

presets.name: Mirror
presets.description: The melody upside down around C3, by steps of the key: up becomes down.

presets.name: Mirror and follow
presets.description: The melody upside down, then fitted to the song's chords.

presets.name: Humanised melody
presets.description: Now and then a note moves a step of the key, so a repeated line never plays quite the same.

presets.name: Wild runs
presets.description: Most notes jump up to four steps of the key either way: a run that keeps changing.

presets.name: Bass range
presets.description: Folds every note into C0 to C2, where a bass line sits.

presets.name: Lead range
presets.description: Folds every note into C3 to C5, where a lead sings.
